text_block_list.name: Spectators
text_block_list.text: (WOOOOAAAHH!!)

From total obscurity to complete dominance 
and stardom. These past three years of the 
Twinkle Series were truly the Kitasan 
Show.

A helpful soul who can never ignore 
someone in trouble. Her reach expands even 
further...

Before long—it even reached the northern 
plains.

text_block_list.name: Kitasan Black
text_block_list.text:
Alright, let's go, everyone! Follow my 
lead!

text_block_list.name: Umamusume Children
text_block_list.text: (WAAAAAAAAAAAAH!)

Chasing after Kitasan Black as she runs, 
the young Umamusume dash on and on...

Both the fast and slow kids were 
overjoyed. And then, after most of them 
were completely worn out...

text_block_list.name: Kitasan Black
text_block_list.text:
Can you still run? You look pretty 
exhausted... Are you okay?

text_block_list.name: Umamusume Child A
text_block_list.text:
Haa, haa, yeah, I'm fine! Running is super 
fun, after all!

text_block_list.name: Umamusume Child A
text_block_list.text:
I wanna... I wanna run in races just like 
Kita-chan!

text_block_list.name: Kitasan Black
text_block_list.text:
"Oh, really?! Then you definitely have to 
make that dream come true someday!"

text_block_list.name: Umamusume Child A
text_block_list.text:
Yeah! Ah, but... that might be a little 
too much.

text_block_list.name: Umamusume Child A
text_block_list.text:
"There aren't any running clubs near my 
place. Plus, there are lots of kids faster 
than me anyway~"

text_block_list.name: Kitasan Black
text_block_list.text:
Hmm, I see~... So for now, you still can't 
run the way you want to.

text_block_list.name: Kitasan Black
text_block_list.text: Right! Alright then, let me see your face!

text_block_list.name: Umamusume Child A
text_block_list.text: My face? Is something wrong with my face?

text_block_list.name: Kitasan Black
text_block_list.text:
I can tell a lot just by looking at your 
face. Let me see~♪

text_block_list.name: Umamusume Child A
text_block_list.text: Y-Yeah, sure...

And so, Kitasan Black peered into the 
little child's eyes...

text_block_list.name: Kitasan Black
text_block_list.text:
(Yeah, such great eyes! Overflowing with 
motivation and sparkling so brightly...!)

text_block_list.name: Kitasan Black
text_block_list.text:
(Her eyes reflect the clear blue of the 
sky. This girl can chase her dreams 
without hesitation...!)

text_block_list.name: Kitasan Black
text_block_list.text:
Yeah, don't worry! I know you can 
definitely come in first place!

text_block_list.name: Umamusume Child A
text_block_list.text:
Huh, how can you tell from their face? 
Shouldn't it be their legs or something?

text_block_list.name: Kitasan Black
text_block_list.text:
Yeah! The easiest way to tell if someone 
can run fast... is by their face and eyes!

text_block_list.name: Kitasan Black
text_block_list.text:
As long as you're brimming with the drive 
to do it, no matter how long it takes, 
you'll never give up and keep charging up 
that hill!

text_block_list.name: Kitasan Black
text_block_list.text: ...Right, Trainer?

I can't predict the exact future or know 
what kinds of Umamusume will run. Even so—

Kitasan Black showed us all. That there 
are things far, far more important than 
pedigree or a flashy running style.

text_block_list.name: Kitasan Black
text_block_list.text:
Diving into an unfamiliar world might be 
scary, but it's okay! Trust me!

text_block_list.name: Kitasan Black
text_block_list.text:
Let's move forward together! I'll always 
lend a hand whenever you're in trouble. 
So, alright?

text_block_list.name: Umamusume Child A
text_block_list.text:
Are you really, really inviting me? But 
racing takes a lot of preparation, right?

text_block_list.name: Umamusume Child A
text_block_list.text:
You see, my family isn't really that 
wealthy, but...

text_block_list.name: Kitasan Black
text_block_list.text:
Ah, about that. You don't need to worry 
about things like that.

text_block_list.name: Kitasan Black
text_block_list.text: We don't need it, right? Dia-chan?

text_block_list.name: Satono Diamond
text_block_list.text: Yes, please leave the support to me.

text_block_list.name: Satono Diamond
text_block_list.text:
We support any girl who has the drive. As 
long as her parents give their consent, 
there's no problem at all.

text_block_list.name: Satono Diamond
text_block_list.text:
You can study running while attending 
school, and we can even arrange a room for 
you to stay in if needed.

text_block_list.name: Satono Diamond
text_block_list.text:
"So please don't worry, and run with all 
your heart."

text_block_list.name: Umamusume Child A
text_block_list.text: Waaah, really, Big Sis!? Yaaaaaay!

text_block_list.name: Kitasan Black
text_block_list.text:
Ahaha, I'm so glad you found a good one, 
Dia-chan.

text_block_list.name: Satono Diamond
text_block_list.text: Yeah. I found someone else on my end too.

text_block_list.name: Umamusume Child B
text_block_list.text:
U-Um... nice to meet you. I want to run 
together too. I-It's nice to meet you...

text_block_list.name: Umamusume Child A
text_block_list.text: Ah, yeah! Let's do our best together!

—A new support initiative. Kitasan Black 
would travel the northern regions on her 
own two feet, backed by the Satono Group.

The dual wheels of leadership and charity 
continue to turn, supporting the Umamusume 
world. And then—

text_block_list.name: Daiwa Scarlet
text_block_list.text:
Not bad, Kitasan! Having a junior push 
this hard in a race really keeps us on our 
toes!

text_block_list.name: Tracen Academy Instructor
text_block_list.text:
They're improving... Every pre-debut girl 
who trained alongside Kitasan Black has 
improved dramatically. This is...

text_block_list.name: Live Director
text_block_list.text:
Thank you, Kitasan Black. The Winning 
Lives you perform in really do bring a 
whole different level of excitement.

text_block_list.name: Racetrack Official
text_block_list.text:
We've gotta make the racetrack even 
better! So it can keep up with the 
excitement of the races!

Smiles... smiles... In every place, a 
circle of smiles is spreading...

text_block_list.name: Kitasan Black
text_block_list.text:
Trainer, another school year is about to 
begin. Let's do our best together.

text_block_list.name: Kitasan Black
text_block_list.text:
The festival we're aiming for is only just 
beginning! We need to go beyond what we're 
capable of—more! More and more...!

"Furthermore, Kitasan Black knows no 
stopping. With sheer drive, she pulls 
everyone along toward the light."

Her caliber is entirely different. The 
scale of her dreams is on another level. 
Who else in the world could make such a 
contribution?

"Words welled up naturally within me. On 
behalf of everyone involved with 
Umamusume..."

text_block_list.name: Kitasan Black
text_block_list.text: Huh? Wh-What's this all of a sudden?
choice_data_list: I'm so glad I could help you... truly.
I'm glad I could help you... truly.

text_block_list.name: Kitasan Black
text_block_list.text:
N-No way! Don't spring that on me so 
suddenly~. I'm the one who should be 
thanking you!

text_block_list.name: Kitasan Black
text_block_list.text:
Looking out for someone like me. Buying 
into me purely for my spirit.

text_block_list.name: Kitasan Black
text_block_list.text:
Still, repaying my debt of gratitude to 
you, Trainer, has only just begun!

text_block_list.name: Kitasan Black
text_block_list.text:
I'll win lots of races, entertain 
everyone, and put the biggest smiles on 
our fans' faces!

text_block_list.name: Kitasan Black
text_block_list.text:
It's okay, I'm not alone! I have so, so 
many friends who are right there with me!

Because she's known hardship, she 
understands the hearts of others— a 
helping-hand leader who reaches out to 
anyone.

A greatness that no mere talented 
Umamusume could ever achieve. Yes, Kitasan 
Black is truly—

"Everyone's sun. Rising steadily from the 
far north, out of everyone's sight—"

She was a sun that finally stood at the 
summit and came to illuminate all things.
